verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a 401(k), a retirement plan, or contributions syncing automatically with each payroll run. The only related items are an API endpoint to create a benefit deduction, which is a developer building block, and a generic claim that Warp Agent handles benefits. Neither shows Warp offering a retirement plan with automatic payroll contribution sync.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can offer a 401(k) or retirement plan whose contributions sync automatically with each payroll
